title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 63
description: Ten questions on Psalms 63: a soul thirsting for God in a dry land, loving kindness better than life, and the shadow of God's wings.

questions.text: Where does the psalmist's flesh long for God, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:1 says this is in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

answers.text: In a green valley by a river
In a dry and weary land

questions.text: Where has the psalmist seen God, watching his power and glory?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:2 says, "So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory."

questions.text: God's loving kindness is better than what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:3 says God's loving kindness is better than life.

questions.text: What will the psalmist lift up in God's name?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:4 says, "I will lift up my hands in your name."

questions.text: With what will the psalmist's soul be satisfied, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:5 says his soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food.

questions.text: When does the psalmist think about God in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:6 says he remembers God on his bed and thinks about him in the night watches.

questions.text: In the shadow of what will the psalmist rejoice?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:7 says, "I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings."

questions.text: What holds the psalmist up, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:8 says, "Your right hand holds me up."

questions.text: What does verse 10 say those who seek his soul will become?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:10 says they shall be given over to the power of the sword and be jackal food.

questions.text: What will happen to the mouth of those who speak lies?
questions.explanation: Psalms 63:11 says the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
